shortDefinition: Including example inputs and outputs in a prompt to guide AI toward the desired response format.
fullDefinition: Few-shot prompting is a prompting technique where you include 1-5 examples of the desired input-output format directly in your prompt. This guides the model's behavior more precisely than instructions alone. It is particularly useful for consistent formatting, classification tasks, and unusual output structures. Zero-shot uses no examples; one-shot uses one; few-shot uses multiple.
